items.prompt:
Read.

'Dogs make the best pets. They are loyal.'

What is the opinion?
A) Dogs make the best pets
B) Dogs are loyal (a reason)
C) Dogs have four legs
items.answer: A) Dogs make the best pets

solution.answer: A) Dogs make the best pets

items.prompt:
Which word gives a REASON?
A) because
B) yesterday
C) blue

steps: 'because' links a reason. Key is A.

items.prompt:
An opinion piece should END with a:
A) new topic
B) conclusion that restates the opinion
C) list of names
items.answer: B) conclusion that restates the opinion

solution.answer: B) conclusion that restates the opinion

items.prompt:
Read.

'Recess is great because we exercise, and we also make friends.'

Which is a REASON?
A) Recess is great
B) We exercise
C) Recess

steps: Supports the opinion. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which sentence is an OPINION (not a fact)?
A) A library has books.
B) The library is the best place in town.
C) Books have pages.
items.answer: B) The library is the best place in town.

solution.answer: B) The library is the best place in town.

items.prompt:
To make an opinion piece stronger, you should give:
A) more reasons
B) more unrelated facts
C) no reasons

steps: Reasons support the opinion. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST opening for an opinion piece about school lunch?
A) Lunch is at noon.
B) I think our school should serve healthier lunches.
C) The cafeteria is big.
items.answer: B) I think our school should serve healthier lunches.

steps: States topic and opinion. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) I think our school should serve healthier lunches.

items.prompt:
Read.

'We should plant a garden. It would give us fresh food. Also, it would make the yard pretty.'

How many reasons are given?
A) None
B) One
C) Two

steps: Fresh food AND pretty yard. Key is C.
